A1 at 1,000 (provisional).observation: Some class contours are clearer than the matched S1 checkpoint, but quality is mixed. The Gyarados row contains compact blue figures with little expected serpentine structure; Metapod repeatedly uses upright rounded forms rather than clear angular cocoons. Noisy texture and wrong anatomy remain elsewhere. Zero pixel-collapse flags do not rule out restricted structural variation or class confusion. The lower pooled FID is provisional evidence, not a complete quality/diversity conclusion.

A1 at 2,000 (provisional).observation: Pooled FID improves further, with recognizable contours in classes such as Eevee and Gengar. Strong semantic/shape errors persist: Gyarados samples remain compact blue figures rather than serpentine creatures, and Metapod uses repeated upright rounded forms. Other classes still have wrong anatomy and texture artifacts. Median pixel diversity is close to matched S1, but that does not resolve structural coverage. Selection remains provisional.

Completed 1-NFE pair, broad review.observation: Broad unblinded review covered fixed sample indices 00/01 for every one of 151 classes, plus six samples in the preselected Eevee/Gyarados/Metapod panels and the confirmation fixed-class gallery. Many classes show distinct compositions and recognizable cues; A1 often has clearer outlines and less noisy surfaces. The improvement is not uniform: both arms have serious shape errors, and A1 sometimes simplifies or changes class structure. Examples include Charizard, Gyarados, Lapras, Metapod and Weedle. No all-class semantic-accuracy score was measured. Pixel diversity is similar between the arms; zero pixel flags do not certify semantic coverage or rule out near-memorization.

S1 at 1,000 (provisional).observation: The 16 fixed classes retain varied compositions and recognizable broad class cues, but noise, edge artifacts and less coherent anatomy/detail are apparent relative to the selected teacher. Pixel-diversity flags are 0/151; this is not a semantic-coverage score. This checkpoint is provisional until the fixed student horizon finishes.

S1 at 2,000 (provisional).observation: Fixed-noise compositions remain varied, with recognizable class cues in many displayed samples. Noisy textures, blurred or fragmented anatomy and inconsistent outlines remain. Higher pixel diversity does not establish improved semantic diversity. All-class pixel-collapse flags remain 0/151; selection is still provisional.

S1 confirmation seed.observation: Different noise produces visibly different compositions in the 16 fixed classes. Gengar, Eevee and Nidorina retain class cues; Gyarados and Metapod still show substantial structural errors, and image texture remains noisy. Confirmation FID is 67.0671 with 0/151 pixel-collapse flags.

S2 at 1,000 (provisional).observation: The fixed 16-class gallery has varied compositions, class cues and relatively clear contours in examples including Eevee, Gengar and Scyther. Distorted limbs, merged anatomy and unclear class-specific shapes remain, including Gyarados and Metapod examples. Zero pixel-collapse flags are not a semantic-coverage measure. Compared across NFE budgets, inference calls, training seed/draws and per-position exposure differ; selection remains provisional.

Selected A1 at 4,000.observation: Final/selected FID is 52.4695 and confirmation FID is 52.3536, compared with S1 66.4564 and 67.0671. The FID advantage persists at all three matched checkpoints but narrows from about 24 points at 1k to 14 points at 4k. Pixel-collapse flags are 0/151 in both final evaluation draws. Visual interpretation remains mixed; see the all-class pair review.

Selected S1 at 4,000.observation: The fixed-class gallery has varied poses/compositions and recognizable class cues in many samples; outlines and faces are clearer than at 1k. Grain/noise, merged parts and incorrect anatomy remain, especially among more complex shapes. This review covers 16 fixed classes, not an all-class recognition score; pixel-collapse flags are 0/151.

Selected T at 30,000.observation: The fixed 16-class gallery shows varied compositions and recognizable class cues, with clearer outlines and details than earlier checkpoints. Anatomy and some class-specific shapes remain imperfect, notably in Gyarados, Metapod and Scyther. No severe common-output collapse is apparent in this subset. All-class pixel diagnostics flag 0/151 classes at both 20k and 30k and at the selected checkpoint. Pixel diversity does not establish all-class semantic coverage.

T at 10,000.observation: Six fixed-noise generations in each of 16 fixed classes show varied color and composition with broad class cues, but distorted anatomy and sometimes ambiguous class features. No severe common-output collapse is apparent in this displayed subset; all-class pixel flags are 0/151.

T at 20,000.observation: Class features are clearer in the fixed gallery, particularly Eevee, Gengar, Kabuto and Starmie, and compositions remain varied. Limb/body distortions and ambiguous shapes remain visible in classes such as Gyarados, Metapod and Scyther. This is a qualitative review of 16 fixed classes, not an all-class recognition score; all-class pixel flags are 0/151.
